entities.summary: Jason Michael Palmer is an American businessman, entrepreneur, investor, and politician who was a candidate in the 2024 Democratic Party presidential primaries. Palmer won the 2024 American Samoa Democratic presidential caucuses, with 51 votes compared to 40 for Joe Biden. He was awarded three of American Samoa's delegates to the 2024 Democratic National Convention. Palmer became the first presidential candidate to win a territory while running against an incumbent president in a presidential primary since Ted Kennedy defeated Jimmy Carter in 13 contests during the 1980 Democratic presidential primaries.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Jason Palmer's victory in the 2024 American Samoa Democratic presidential caucuses marks a significant regional development in the US political landscape, as he became the first candidate to win a territory while running against an incumbent president. This achievement has implications for the 2024 US presidential election.
